About

Da$Nomad v1.0

Personal currency converter

Offline-capable PWA built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Keeps four currencies in view with live mid-market rates.

Privacy

This app does not collect, store, or share any personal data on our servers. Your preferences (selected currencies, home location/timezone) are stored locally on your device using localStorage. On startup, the app may request an approximate location from BigDataCloud based on your IP address to select a nearby currency. If you choose "Use my current location", the app requests device location permission and sends coordinates to BigDataCloud for reverse geocoding; coordinates may also be sent to Open-Meteo for weather. Exchange rates are fetched from public APIs (ExchangeRate-API/Open ER API) with no personally identifiable information attached.

Full privacy policy

Terms of Use

This app is provided "as is" for personal use. Rates are for informational purposes only and should not be used for trading or financial decisions. Use of third-party APIs is subject to their respective terms. You are responsible for compliance with local laws in your jurisdiction.
